title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 第八十章 人鼎云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 八十一章 情虫
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
林灵素道：“在那白鹿观里，我曾听那些牛鼻子说过魔门，得知这两人竟是妖人的头领，不由惊出了一身冷汗，心想，这两人杀人如麻，连人肉都敢吃，又怎会跟我讲什么信义？我写出敖无名的图谱后，必定会被他们吃下肚去。”
他虽是魔帝，却似乎并未将魔门中人看作同道，左一个“魔门”，又一个“妖人”，说得顺溜坦荡。
又道：“于是我装作想不起壁上字画，每天故意苦苦思索，拖延时间，被他们催得急了，就写上十句八句。那两人看了之后，越发相信是敖无名所留的秘谱，心痒难搔，越发着急地催促。
“两人生怕我逃脱，每天一人离开，必定留下另一个在山顶看着我。到了中午，离开的人必定带着一对童男童女回来。这两人为了练‘鼎炉大法’，非得吃纯阳、纯阴的童子，以调和阴阳，滋补元炁。
“我饿了三天，到了第四天凌晨，头晕眼花，实在捱不住了，便在火堆里挖出一截断腿，闭着眼睛啃了下去。嘿嘿，想不到人肉的味道竟是这般鲜美，只是吃在口中，想起那两个童子的模样，仍是忍不住的恶心和恐惧。
“陆成仇坐起身，大笑道：‘这就对了！弱肉强食，天经地义。要想活命，就别假慈悲，装君子。’
“和这两人相处越久，我越知道难逃一死。敖青青貌若桃李，心如蛇蝎，那姓陆的老怪物更是心胸狭隘，嗜杀成性。我以为他们觊觎的是敖无名的秘谱，所以故意在紧要的地方错漏些句子，或干脆颠倒顺序，只盼他们照此修炼，走火入魔。可他们却似对秘谱口诀兴致不大，反倒不断地问我壁上所刻的图画。
“第七天夜里子时，我突觉丹田剧痛，直疼得遍地打滚，生不如死，仿佛从里到外被撕裂成万千碎片。敖青青笑道：‘你且忍忍，陆郎给你找药去啦。’过不多时，老怪物骑鸟回来，将一个道士抛在洞前。
“两人又一前一后，吸干那道士的真气，转存入我丹田之中。两股真气交相抵撞，疼痛反而消了大半。
“后来我才知道，原来‘鼎炉大法’中的‘人鼎’只能‘用’七日。过了七天，炁丹在玄窍内成型，与‘人鼎’五行冲克，‘人鼎’纵然不死也必定发狂。我没说出石图下落，那两人自然不能让我死，所以才用新的炁丹来克制旧的炁丹。
“此后每隔七日，丹田内必定剧痛如绞，那两人总是依法炮制，找来‘人药’，将他的真元输入我的体内。但炁丹越积越多，无法化融吸纳，虽然能缓解一时的疼痛，却如同饮鸩止渴，一次比一次发作得更加猛烈。
“过了一个多月，那两人见我画出的图谱都与‘炼天石图’不相干，越来越不耐烦，让我回忆有没有地图或与地理相关的文字记述。我一边假装冥思苦想，一边套话，才知道原来敖无名那一身通神彻鬼的本领都是从蓬山得来！”
众人心中俱是一紧，嘭嘭大跳，又听他说道：“当年魔门衰败，敖无名的父母全都死在青城道士的剑下。他为了报仇雪恨，潜入青城，连杀了几十人，又悄悄掘了青城掌门的石墓，想要鞭尸泄恨，谁想却在石棺壁上发现了青城剑谱。他福至心灵，既然青城掌门会将剑谱陪葬，那么其他各派的掌门呢？于是又辗转各地，挖掘了峨嵋、龙虎、茅山、阁皂、华山等派的坟墓……”
舱内哄然。这些道士虽是神霄派门下，但有一些却是带艺投师，从其他道派转过来的，听说从前的师门竟被妖人掘墓，仍不免惊怒填膺。
林灵素听若罔闻，续道：“他掘了七十几座墓，果然挖到了五十多门派的心诀秘谱，修为大涨。挖掘昆仑古墓时，发现了一幅古代的海图。他大感好奇，按着图示乘船出海，经历惊涛骇浪，九死一生，竟然到了传说中的蓬莱，学到了上古神功。但不知为何，没有最终修成，便又离开蓬莱，回中原报仇。
“此后十年，他纵横天下，无人可敌。金山寺的照影和尚不知使了什么奸计，竟神不知鬼不觉地将他困在了伏魔塔中，塔壁上的图谱就是他所留下的各派心法与蓬山绝学。
“敖无名曾对敖青青说过，他所学的本领，不过是蓬山的九牛一毛，仅此皮毛，已足以称霸天下，如果能窥全貌，嘿嘿，纵使神仙也非敌手！
“我越听越是激动，从那一刻起，便打定主意要到蓬山一窥究竟。但要想到蓬山，就必须甩脱这两人，找到敖无名所留的‘石图’。于是我一边胡诌应付，拖延时间，一边寻找机会逃之夭夭。
“那两人看得极紧，就连我解手、睡觉，也始终有一人寸步不离。又过了几日，老怪物下山‘觅食’，抓了一对童子回来，那少年穿着道袍，唇红齿白，满脸惊慌羞怯的神色，居然是许久不见的王文卿……”
众道士哗然大怒，纷纷斥其胡说八道。

林灵素哈哈笑道：“王娘子没和你们说过，所谓的‘火师’、‘电母’就是陆成仇和敖青青这对魔头么？陆成仇那老怪物见他皮肉细嫩，早馋得口水直流，搭起锅笼，便欲将他清蒸了吃。他认出是我，泪珠在眼眶里滚来滚去，又是惊惶又是可怜，想要哀求，却什么话也说不出来。
“我灵机一动，道：‘我想起来啦！我在伏魔塔里禁闭时，曾看见佛龛后的石缝里藏了一卷青色的皮轴，当时以为是佛经，未曾细看，现在回想起来，上面画了些岛屿，还标了些文字，一定就是敖护法留下的‘石图’！’
“那两人听了又惊又喜，生怕石图已经烧毁，便想立即赶往金山寺，顾不上吃什么童子肉了。我又编了理由劝阻，说那些和尚救火时既然已经发现了敖无名刻在塔壁上的图谱，必定也已找到了‘石图’。为了防止他们再来盗图，一定会藏在寺里隐秘之处，严加布防。这般生抢豪夺，只是自投罗网，倒不如设法混入寺里，见机行事。
“老怪物果然中计，道：‘小子，你对金山寺了如指掌，就由你来带路。’我假意推脱，说那些和尚全都认得我，我又杀了方丈，回去定是死路一条。嘿嘿，那两人一心抢到石图，哪会管我的死活？敖青青取出一张人皮面具，敷在我的脸上，将我乔化成一个马脸和尚，自己则用障眼法变成一个小沙弥。
“我担心他们杀了王文卿灭口，便提议将他也乔化成沙弥，倘若到时惊动了金山寺的和尚，还能拿他当诱饵，声东击西，引开追兵。敖青青似是看透了我的心思，笑道：‘啧啧，小和尚喜欢上小道士啦。’取出两个黑丸送入我们的口里，道：‘小滑头，你可别耍什么心眼，否则这食心蛊发作起来，会让你恨不得将自己的心肝挖出来。’
“那时我只道她是胡诌恫吓，丝毫不以为意，倒是王文卿惊魂不定，脸色忽白忽紫，不断地伸手抠嗓子眼，想要将蛊丸呕出来。嘿嘿，却不知这狼心狗肺、恩将仇报的东西，又哪有心肝可剖？当日我若能预见他的所作所为，早就该让老怪物将他千刀万剐，一片一片吃下肚去。”
众道士见他三句五句不离辱骂师尊，无不火冒三丈，若非被萨守坚喝止，只怕又有些年少气盛的要跳将起来与他拼命。
许宣双腿忽然一震，脚趾也已能够活动，心中大喜。
他修为尚浅，所能调用的金丹真气不过十分之一，然而仅此一成，威力已颇为强猛。与小青一起循环传气了半晌，麻痹的经脉有如春涧融冰，潺潺奔流，已几乎全部打通。
船身晃动得越来越剧烈，时而高高抛起，重重撞落；时而侧倾掀转，险些翻覆。
众人盘坐舱内，忽而前俯后仰，忽而东倒西歪，全神贯注地聆听着林灵素的忆述，浑然忘却了紧张与害怕。
林灵素道：“那天夜里正值十五，月亮又圆又亮。寺里人影稀落，和尚都聚集在殿里替了尘诵经超度，只有十几个巡寺的沙弥提着灯来回穿梭。敖青青疑心极重，让我与王娘子走在前面，他们则遥遥相随。
“金山寺依山而建，地势复杂，伏魔塔、藏经阁被烧塌了大半，到处都是残垣断壁，望去更显杂乱。
“我在寺里待了大半年，知道前方草坡下就是塔林。那千余座石塔藏埋着寺里由古至今的所有秃驴骨灰，参差错立，如同迷宫一般。眼见前方灯光闪烁，来了几个巡寺沙弥，我趁机高声大叫：‘天后小心，有埋伏！’拉着王文卿翻身滚下草坡。”

content_en:
Lin Lingsu said: "In the White Deer Temple, I once heard those bull noses talk about the Demon Sect. When I learned that these two people were actually the leaders of the demons, I couldn't help but break out in a cold sweat. I thought, these two people are murderous and dare to eat human flesh. How can they tell me what kind of faith they have? After I write Ao Wuming's atlas, they will definitely eat it."
Although he is the Demon Emperor, he does not seem to regard the people in the Demon Sect as his colleagues. There is a "Demon Sect" on the left and a "demon" on the other, speaking smoothly and frankly.
He added: "So I pretended that I couldn't remember the calligraphy and painting on the wall, and deliberately thought hard every day to delay time. When they urged me to hurry, I wrote ten or eight sentences. After the two people read it, they became more and more convinced that it was the secret score left by Ao Wuming. They were itching and urged them more and more anxiously.
"The two of them were afraid that I would escape. Every day when one of them left, the other would be left watching me from the top of the mountain. At noon, those who left must return with a boy and a girl. In order to practice the 'Cauldron Dafa', these two people had to eat pure yang and pure yin boys to reconcile yin and yang and nourish Yuan Qi.
"I was hungry for three days. In the early morning of the fourth day, I felt dizzy and couldn't stand it anymore, so I dug out a severed leg from the fire and gnawed it with my eyes closed. Hey, I didn't expect that the taste of human flesh was so delicious. Just eating it in my mouth, thinking about the appearance of the two boys, I still couldn't help feeling sick and scared.
"Lu Chengchou sat up and laughed and said, 'That's right! It is natural that the weak should eat the strong. If you want to survive, don't pretend to be compassionate or pretend to be a gentleman. ’
"The longer I get along with these two people, the more I know that death is inevitable. Ao Qingqing is as beautiful as a peach and a plum, and has a heart like a snake and scorpion. The old monster named Lu is even more narrow-minded and murderous. I thought they were coveting Ao Wuming's secret genealogy. So I deliberately missed some sentences in important places, or simply reversed the order, hoping that they would practice accordingly and become obsessed with it. However, they seemed not to be very interested in the secret formula, and instead kept asking me about the pictures carved on the wall.
"At midnight on the seventh day, I suddenly felt a sharp pain in my Dantian, which made me roll all over the place. I felt worse than death, as if I was being torn into thousands of pieces from the inside out. Ao Qingqing smiled and said, "Just be patient, Lu Lang is going to find medicine for you." ’ After a while, the old monster came back on a bird and threw a Taoist priest in front of the cave.
"The two of them worked in tandem, sucking up the Taoist priest's true energy and transferring it to my Dantian. The two streams of true energy collided with each other, and most of the pain disappeared.
“Later I found out that the ‘human tripod’ in the ‘Cauldron Dafa’ can only be ‘used’ for seven days. After seven days, Qi Dan took shape in the mysterious orifice and clashed with the five elements of the 'Human Cauldron'. Even if the 'Human Cauldron' did not die, it would definitely go crazy. I didn't tell the whereabouts of Shi Tu, so those two people naturally couldn't let me die, so they used new Qi Dan to restrain the old Qi Dan.
"After that, every seven days, there would be severe pain in my Dantian. The two people always followed the law and found 'human medicine' to inject his true essence into my body. However, more and more Qi Dan accumulated and could not be absorbed. Although it could relieve the pain for a while, it was like drinking poison to quench thirst, and the attacks became more violent each time.
"More than a month later, the two people saw that the maps I drew were not related to the 'Heaven Refining Stone Map', and they became increasingly impatient and asked me to recall whether there were any maps or written descriptions related to geography. I pretended to be thinking hard while making excuses, and then I realized that Ao Wuming’s ability to communicate with gods and ghosts came from Pengshan! "
Everyone's hearts tightened and they jumped loudly when they heard him say again: "When the Demon Sect declined, Ao Wuming's parents all died under the swords of Qingcheng Taoist priests. In order to avenge his hatred, he sneaked into Qingcheng and killed dozens of people. He also secretly dug up the stone tomb of the leader of Qingcheng, hoping to whip the corpse to vent his hatred. Unexpectedly, he discovered the Qingcheng sword manual on the wall of the stone coffin. He is blessed in his soul. Since the head of Qingcheng will be buried with the sword manual, what about the heads of other sects? So he traveled to various places and excavated the tombs of Emei, Longhu, Maoshan, Gezao, Huashan and other sects..."There was an uproar in the cabin. Although these Taoist priests were disciples of the Shenxiao sect, some of them were sect masters who had transferred from other Taoist sects. When they heard that the graves of their former sects had been dug up by demons, they were still filled with shock and anger.
Lin Lingsu listened as if he had heard nothing, and continued: "He dug more than seventy tombs, and indeed he found the secrets of more than fifty sects, and his cultivation level increased greatly. When digging the Kunlun ancient tomb, he found an ancient sea map. He was very curious. , followed the diagram and took a boat out to sea, experienced turbulent waves, and narrowly escaped death, and actually arrived in the legendary Penglai, where he learned the ancient magical skills. However, for some reason, he did not finally succeed, so he left Penglai and returned to the Central Plains for revenge.
"In the next ten years, he dominated the world and was unrivaled. The Zhaoying monk of Jinshan Temple didn't know what treacherous plot he had used, but he trapped him in the Demon-Conquering Tower without anyone noticing. The diagrams on the wall of the tower are the mental techniques of various schools and Pengshan's secret knowledge that he left behind.
"Ao Wuming once told Ao Qingqing that the skills he learned were just a drop in the bucket of Pengshan. This is enough to dominate the world. If he could see the whole picture, hehe, even gods would not be his opponents!
“The more I listened, the more excited I became. From that moment on, I made up my mind to go to Pengshan to have a closer look. But if you want to get to Pengshan, you must get rid of these two people and find the 'stone map' left by Ao Wuming. So I made nonsense to deal with it, stalled for time, and looked for opportunities to escape.
"Those two people watched closely. Even when I was relieving myself or sleeping, one of them was always with me. A few days later, the old monster went down the mountain to 'forage' and caught a pair of boys. The boy was wearing a monk's robe, with red lips and white teeth, and a look of panic and shyness on his face. He turned out to be Wang Wenqing, whom he hadn't seen for a long time..."
All the Taoist priests were furious and accused him of talking nonsense.
Lin Lingsu laughed and said, "Didn't Madam Wang tell you that the so-called 'Fire Master' and 'Dian Mu' are the devils Lu Chengchou and Ao Qingqing? Seeing his tender skin and flesh, the old monster Lu Chengchou drooled with greed. He set up a pot and wanted to steam him and eat him. He recognized me, and tears rolled in his eyes. He was frightened and pitiful. He wanted to beg, but he couldn't say anything.
"I had an idea and said, 'I remembered it! When I was in confinement in the Demon-Conquering Pagoda, I once saw a blue leather scroll hidden in the stone crevice behind the Buddhist niche. At that time, I thought it was a Buddhist scripture, but I never looked at it carefully. Now that I think about it, there are some islands drawn on it and some words marked on it. It must be the 'stone map' left by Protector Ao! ’
"The two people were surprised and happy after hearing this. They were afraid that the stone map had been burned, so they wanted to rush to Jinshan Temple immediately without worrying about eating boy meat. I made up a reason to dissuade them, saying that when the monks were putting out the fire, they had already discovered Ao Wuming carved on the wall of the tower. The map must have been found in the "Stone Map". In order to prevent them from stealing the map again, they will definitely hide it in a secret place in the temple and strictly guard it. If they want to rob someone like this, they will just fall into a trap. It is better to try to sneak into the temple and act according to the situation.
"As expected, the old monster fell into the trap and said: 'Boy, you know Jinshan Temple well, so you will lead the way. ’ I pretended to shirk, saying that all the monks knew me, and I killed the abbot, so I would definitely die if I went back. Hehe, those two people are so focused on grabbing the stone map, how can they care about my life and death? Ao Qingqing took out a human skin mask and put it on my face, turning me into a horse-faced monk, while he used a blindfold to become a little novice monk.
"I was worried that they would kill Wang Wenqing to silence him, so I proposed that he should be transformed into a novice monk. If the monks of Jinshan Temple were alerted, he could be used as bait to lure the pursuers away. Ao Qingqing seemed to have read through my mind and said with a smile: ‘Tsk, tsk, the little monk has fallen in love with the little Taoist priest.’ He took out two black pills and put them into our mouths and said, ‘Little slicker, don’t be so mean, otherwise this heart-eating poison will make you want to dig out your heart and liver.’
"At that time, I only thought she was making nonsense threats, and I didn't think so at all.However, Wang Wenqing was in shock, his face turned white and purple, and he kept reaching out to dig at his throat, trying to vomit out the Gu pills. Hehe, but I don’t know that this ruthless person, who repays kindness with hatred, has no heart to break it? If I could have foreseen what he did that day, I should have let the old monster cut him into pieces and eat him piece by piece. "
All the Taoist priests were furious when they saw him insulting their master frequently. If Sa Shoujian hadn't stopped him, some of the young and energetic ones would have jumped up and fought with him.
Xu Xuan's legs suddenly shook and he could move his toes. He was overjoyed.
His cultivation is still shallow, and he can only summon one-tenth of the golden elixir's true energy. However, only this one-tenth is already quite powerful. After circulating Qi with Xiao Qing for a long time, the paralyzed meridians were almost all opened up, like melting ice in a spring stream.
The hull of the ship shook more and more violently, sometimes being thrown high and crashing down heavily; sometimes it was tilted sideways and almost capsized.
Everyone sat cross-legged in the cabin, sometimes leaning forward and backward, sometimes swaying this way and that, listening intently to Lin Lingsu's recollections, completely forgetting their nervousness and fear.
Lin Lingsu said: "It was the fifteenth day that night, and the moon was round and bright. There were only a few people in the temple. The monks gathered in the hall to chant sutras for Chen to be saved. There were only a dozen novices visiting the temple walking back and forth carrying lamps. Ao Qingqing was extremely suspicious and asked Madam Wang and I to walk in front, while they followed us from a distance.
"Jinshan Temple is built on a mountain. The terrain is complex. Most of the Demon-Conquering Pagoda and Sutra-Tiding Pavilion were burned down. There are ruins everywhere, making it look even more chaotic.
"I have stayed in the temple for more than half a year, and I know that under the grassy slope in front of me is the Tallinn. The more than a thousand stone pagodas hide the ashes of all the donkeys in the temple from ancient times to the present. They stand staggered and staggered like a maze. Seeing the lights flickering in front of me, a few novice monks came to visit the temple. I took the opportunity to shout loudly: 'The Queen, be careful, there is an ambush! ’ He pulled Wang Wenqing over and rolled down the grassy slope. "
